descriptions.w3d_d26b_scheme_load_8008cf40: Scheme data load: looks up the property "GM.SchemeData" (0x800fc330), resets the weapon tables 0x80431c80 (39 entries) and 0x80431db8 (20 entries) to count 0 with their indices, then for each of 48 settings of the info pointer array copies the value +28 into the entry count when the setting +32 is not -1, or in fallback mode writes a fixed count of 1 to 4 instead; seven entries are always set to 0.
